## SEO release record

- [ ] I recorded the hypothesis, affected URLs and queries, and a verified Search Console baseline (or marked why it is unavailable).
- [ ] I scoped this release to one primary change and documented URL redirects and canonicals if applicable.
- [ ] I tested the final Worker response on affected and representative routes, including titles, canonical, H1, navigation, footer, indexability, and links.
- [ ] I ran the build and relevant guards, and planned a live production check.
- [ ] I recorded the prior commit for rollback and scheduled one-week and two-week reviews.
- [ ] Any NYHUT.com order or payment change is in that site's separate release.

Details and release note format: [SEO release rules](../SEO_RELEASE_RULES.md).
